semantics.refinement: exact equality of complete retained vectors; duplicate execution establishes a zero numerical floor
semantics.labels: controller/attractor labels are excluded from behavior construction and refinement and used only for held-out diagnostics
semantics.rank: calculated only after partition refinement and never used as an inference reward

partition_refinement.starting_partition: 44 matched controller/attractor pair blocks whose within-pair layer-0 directed-QK tensors are bit-identical in the independently checked base artifact; equality between different pair blocks is not assumed

retained_congruence_check.premise: exact equality under all nine primitive third-order observations
retained_congruence_check.consequent: exact equality under all sixteen retained depth-two conditional observations

held_out_role_diagnostics.protocol: formation and counterexample selection are label-free; these span comparisons are calculated afterward

scope.establishes: finite exact future-behavior observations and counterexample-guided refinement on the retained Stories15M contexts
scope.does_not_establish: an exhaustive continuation quotient, a completion observer, or an inference speedup
